name: SUBMIT_MESSAGE
description: Submit a message to a Hedera Consensus Service (HCS) topic. Messages are immutably recorded with a consensus timestamp and sequence number. If the topic has a submit key, the corresponding key must be provided.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Submit key signing via freeze + sign pattern
implicitBehaviors.details: If submitPrivateKey is provided, the transaction is frozen with freezeWith() then signed with the submit key. Required when the topic has a submit key that differs from the operator.
After successful submission, receipt.topicSequenceNumber contains the sequence number assigned to this message.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Large messages are chunked automatically by the SDK
implicitBehaviors.details: Messages exceeding 1KB are split into chunks by TopicMessageSubmitTransaction. This costs more but is handled transparently.

inputs.name: topicId
inputs.describe: The topic ID to submit the message to

inputs.name: message
inputs.describe: The message content (text or base64-encoded binary)

inputs.name: submitPrivateKey
inputs.describe: Submit key (required if the topic has a submit key and it differs from operator key)

successData.name: topicId
successData.describe: The topic ID the message was submitted to

successData.name: sequenceNumber
successData.describe: The sequence number assigned to the message

errorMap.details: The topic ID does not exist on this network.
This topic has expired and no longer accepts messages.
